{{Quote|Lord Vader has shown me the location of a ''third'' Rebel patrol. This is what has brought us to the ''Ejolus'' system. We have been given one ''final chance'' to redeem ourselves. I know&hellip; you will ''all'' do your duty...|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Demmings]], to the crew of the [[Reprisal (Imperial II-class)|''Reprisal'']]|<ref name="Empire 35" />}}
The '''Ejolus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the planet [[Ejolus]].
